facts.business: Tata Teleservices (Maharashtra) Limited provides telecommunication services including data, voice, SMS gateway, and infrastructure sharing to SMEs in the Indian domestic market under a Unified License.
key_risks: Accuracy of revenue recorded given complexity of IT systems and billing
Significant litigations related to regulatory, direct tax and indirect tax matters
Unpredictable market conditions, competition and technology changes impacting useful lives of assets
Assumptions regarding continuation of credit from lenders
facts.related_party_note: Payable to related party: Rs 0.03 crore (March 31, 2026) and Rs 21.75 crore (March 31, 2025); Provision towards indemnification included in other provisions (Note 1.2)
